title: Traffic Classification in an Increasingly Encrypted Web
authors: Akbari, Iman; Salahuddin, Mohammad A.; Aniva, Leni; Limam, Noura; Boutaba, Raouf; Mathieu, Bertrand; Moteau, Stephanie; Tuffin, Stephane
notes: Protocol-agnostic feature engineering for encrypted web traffic using flow statistics and TLS handshake bytes; directly relevant to ETTH's metadata-only approach.

title: A Survey on TLS-Encrypted Malware Network Traffic Analysis Applicable to Security Operations Centers
authors: Oh, Chaeyeon; Ha, Joonseo; Roh, Heejun
notes: Comprehensive survey of TLS-encrypted NTA for SOCs; covers TLS fingerprinting

title: A survey on encrypted network traffic analysis applications, techniques, and countermeasures
authors: Papadogiannaki, Eirini; Ioannidis, Sotiris
notes: Broad survey of encrypted traffic analysis; discusses deployment models and machine-learning pipelines for SOCs.

title: Towards identification of network applications in encrypted traffic
authors: Matousek, Petr; Burgetova, Ivana; Rysavy, Ondrej; Victor, Malombe
notes: Compares JA3/JA4/ML/SNI for application identification; introduces annotated TLS dataset; highlights shared fingerprint limitations.

title: Deciphering Malware's use of TLS (without Decryption)
authors: Anderson, Blake; Paul, Subharthi; McGrew, David
venue: Journal of Computer Virology and Hacking Techniques
notes: Seminal Cisco study showing malware TLS usage differs from benign traffic; addresses sandbox bias; 90%+ family attribution from single encrypted flow.

title: TLS Encrypted Application Classification Using Machine Learning with Flow Feature Engineering
authors: Barut, O.; Zhu, R.; Luo, Y.; Zhang, T.
venue: Proceedings of the 10th International Conference on Communication and Network Security (ACM CNS)
notes: Proposes flow feature engineering for TLS-encrypted application classification; uses RF and CNN; achieves 0.929 macro-F1 on non-vpn2016 dataset.

title: Open Sourcing JA3
authors: Althouse, John B.; Atkinson, Jeff; Atkins, Josh; Lindeman, Laura
notes: Original announcement of JA3; explains MD5 hashing of ClientHello fields and GREASE handling; foundational for TLS fingerprinting.

title: TLS Fingerprinting with JA3 and JA3S
authors: Althouse, John B.; Lindeman, Laura
notes: Extends JA3 to server-side fingerprinting (JA3S); discusses combined client-server fingerprinting for malware detection.

title: On Reliability of JA3 Hashes for Fingerprinting Mobile Applications
authors: Matousek, Petr; Burgetova, Ivana; Rysavy, Ondrej; Victor, Malombe
notes: Empirical evaluation of JA3 stability and uniqueness for mobile apps; reports collision rates; concludes JA3 alone is insufficient for reliable identification.

title: JA4+ Network Fingerprinting
authors: Althouse, John
notes: Introduces JA4 human-readable fingerprint format; covers TLS over TCP/QUIC/DTLS; ALPN handling; successor to JA3.

title: Accurate TLS Fingerprinting using Destination Context and Approximate Matching
authors: Anderson, Blake; McGrew, David
notes: Proposes destination-aware TLS fingerprinting (mercury); addresses JA3 collision problem; achieves F1 > 0.99 for process identification.

title: TLS Encrypted Client Hello (ECH)
authors: IETF
notes: Defines ECH extension encrypting SNI and ALPN; directly impacts TLS visibility and fingerprinting assumptions for ETTH.

title: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) Defense Strategies
authors: Cisco
notes: Operational analysis of ECH impact on network security controls; discusses SNI loss and fallback strategies using EVE fingerprinting.

title: Flow Interaction Graph Analysis: Unknown Encrypted Malicious Traffic Detection
authors: Fu, Chuanpu; Li, Qi; Xu, Ke
notes: Proposes HyperVision unsupervised graph-based detector for unknown encrypted malicious traffic; captures flow interaction patterns; 13.9% accuracy improvement over SOTA.

title: Detecting Stealthy Cobalt Strike C&C Activities via Multi-Flow based Machine Learning
authors: Ramos, Fabian Martin; Wang, Xinyuan
notes: Multi-flow ML features for encrypted Cobalt Strike HTTPS Beacon detection; 90.9% TPR and 0.4% FPR on real-world attack traffic.

title: A Machine Learning Based Approach to Detect Stealthy Cobalt Strike C&C Traffic
authors: Martin Ramos, Fabian; Wang, Xinyuan
notes: Flow-based RF detection of Cobalt Strike Beacon; validates on real-world cyberattack traffic; 50% detection rate with 1.4% FPR.

title: Beaconing Detection in Encrypted Traffic: A SCADA-Based Hybrid Approach Using Zeek Metadata and Isolation Forest
authors: Zhang, Y.; et al.
notes: Hybrid beacon detection using Zeek conn.log metadata and Isolation Forest; payload-independent; 94.59% accuracy on SCADA encrypted traffic.

title: Real-Time Encrypted Traffic Classification in Programmable Networks with P4 and Machine Learning
authors: Akem, A. T.-J.; Fraysse, G.; Fiore, M.
notes: In-switch Random Forest for encrypted traffic classification using only packet size and IAT features; 95% QUIC accuracy; line-rate inference.

title: Efficient Distribution-Derived Features for High-Speed Encrypted Flow Classification
authors: Garcia, J.; Korhonen, T.; Andersson, R.; Vastlund, F.
venue: ACM SIGCOMM Workshop on Network Meets AI & ML (NetAI)
notes: Evaluates histogram-based distribution features (KSD) for encrypted flow classification; demonstrates packet-size and IAT distribution features with Random Forest.

title: SoK: Decoding the Enigma of Encrypted Network Traffic Classifiers
authors: Wickramasinghe, Nimesha; Shaghaghi, Arash; Tsudik, Gene; Jha, Sanjay
venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P)
notes: Systematization of ML-based NTC; reveals reliance on outdated datasets; 348 occlusion experiments showing overfitting and SNI data leakage.

title: Data Drift in DL: Lessons Learned From Encrypted Traffic Classification
authors: Malekghaini, Navid; Akbari, Elham; Salahuddin, Mohammad; Limam, Noura; Boutaba, Raouf; Mathieu, Bertrand; Moteau, Stephanie; Tuffin, Stephane
notes: Studies data/concept drift effects on deep learning encrypted traffic classifiers; proposes architectural adaptations for robustness across datasets and time.

title: Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Encrypted Traffic
authors: Singh, Kalindi; Kashyap, Aayush; Cherukuri, Aswani Kumar
notes: Applies XGBoost, Random Forest, and Isolation Forest with SHAP explainability to encrypted traffic anomaly detection; 99.94% accuracy on CIC-Darknet2020.

title: Explainable AI for Forensic Analysis: A Comparative Study of SHAP and LIME in Intrusion Detection Models
authors: Grabowski, Adam; Xu, Shengjie
notes: Compares SHAP and LIME for XGBoost/TabNet on UNSW-NB15; evaluates fidelity, consistency, and forensic relevance for IDS explainability.

title: A new classification method for encrypted internet traffic using machine learning
authors: Ugurlu, Mesut; Dogru, Ibrahim Alper; Arslan, Recep Sinan
venue: Turkish Journal of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences
notes: Compares XGBoost, Decision Tree, and Random Forest for encrypted traffic classification; XGBoost achieves 94.53% accuracy on ISCX VPN-nonVPN.

title: Deep-Forest-Based Encrypted Malicious Traffic Detection
authors: Zhang, H.; et al.
notes: Proposes DF-IDS deep-forest framework for small-scale unbalanced SSL/TLS encrypted malicious traffic; integrates RF and Extra Trees; outperforms DL baselines.

title: The Sweet Danger of Sugar: Debunking Representation Learning for Encrypted Traffic Classification
authors: Zhao, Yuqi; Dettori, Giovanni; Boffa, Matteo; Vassio, Luca; Mellia, Marco
notes: Critical analysis of representation learning for encrypted traffic; shows reported successes rely on data leakage and shortcuts; introduces Pcap-Encoder and frozen-encoder evaluation.

title: Bias in the Shadows: Explore Shortcuts in Encrypted Network Traffic Classification
authors: Wang, Chuyi; Xie, Xiaohui; Wang, Tongze; Cui, Yong
notes: Proposes BiasSeeker framework for detecting dataset-specific shortcut features in NTC; evaluates across 19 public datasets; emphasizes context-aware feature selection.

title: Drift-Based Dataset Stability Benchmark
authors: Malekghaini, Navid; et al.
notes: Proposes MFWDD drift detection method and dataset stability benchmarking workflow for encrypted traffic ML models; identifies weak spots in long-term dataset performance.
